response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial project contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in production routing or geospatial data pipelines, and his recent work is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js, making his fit for this role uncertain despite clear technical curiosity and open-source initiative.
strengths: Built and maintained an open-source geospatial platform (GISCollective) used by real-world organizations.
Demonstrated ability to work across diverse tech stacks and contribute to distributed systems and DevOps infrastructure.
Strong track record of technical communication, workshops, and open-source contributions showing intellectual curiosity.
concerns: No evidence of commercial C++ or Rust development, which are core requirements for the role.
Recent roles focus on TypeScript/Node.js and web platforms, with minimal exposure to routing, navigation, or real-time map tile pipelines.
Geospatial experience is community-driven and not in a high-scale, production routing or traffic-integrated system.
